title: EndeavorFormationAttempt (DESIGN.md §16.3 verbatim; immutable per-attempt envelope; C2)
description: The §16.3 record verbatim: one immutable authentication/transport envelope per send. UNIQUE(formation_id, attempt_ordinal) and UNIQUE(attempt_nonce) (enforced in code). Every attempt proves fresh authentication over canonical_command_digest || idempotency_domain_digest || attempt_nonce || attempt_recovery_binding_digest and the server-derived current actor binding; Kovee persists each envelope rather than overwriting evidence of an earlier send, and resolving an intent never rewrites an earlier attempt's send/authentication evidence (§16.3). Closed attempt machine: prepared→sent when bytes may first leave Kovee; prepared→canceled only before that point; sent→reply_received | transport_unknown; transport_unknown→reply_received on a valid late reply or →reconciled when a later query/terminalization supplies the exact resolution digest; reply_received, reconciled, canceled terminal.

attempt_nonce.description: Per-attempt nonce, globally unique (UNIQUE(attempt_nonce)); excluded from canonical_command_digest so a retry preserves semantic bytes and idempotency while replacing only the expiring proof/binding envelope (§16.3).

state.description: §16.3 verbatim; reply_received, reconciled, and canceled are terminal attempt states.

oneOf.$comment: prepared→canceled happens only before bytes may first leave Kovee, so neither state carries a send time (§16.3).

identifier.description: Opaque visible-ASCII identifier, at most 128 bytes (§14.9).

safeNonNegativeInteger.description: I-JSON safe integer (§14.2 rejects unsafe integers).

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC instant with Z offset. DESIGN.md does not fix a timestamp wire encoding; this derivation freezes with the bundle (gap note G3).

digestRef.$comment: The closed family DigestRef wire (family-vectors/PROFILE.md §6.1, normative; D-R0-1): exactly the members {class, algorithm, key_ref?, value_hex}. The oneOf pins the closed class/algorithm pairing and requires key_ref exactly for the keyed erasure classes; each arm refines members of this already-closed object.

class.description: Digest class (PROFILE.md §6, D-R0-1); substituting one class where a schema requires another is a conformance failure.

key_ref.description: Key id for the keyed erasure classes; raw HMAC keys, per-object secrets, and salts are never part of a DigestRef.

digestRef.description: Typed DigestRef: every digest field is typed, never an unlabelled hash. Wire shape, class/algorithm pairing, and key_ref presence per the ratified family profile.

key_ref.description: Per-Society index key id; the raw key is never part of the ref.

idempotencyDomainDigest.description: The IdempotencyDomain digest (§14.2; PROFILE.md §5, D-R0-1): always the keyed scope_erasure_safe class over the per-Society index key — a public class here is a conformance failure.
